mapper.select: SELECT agent_id, tool_id, auth_mode, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_tool_policy WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY tool_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_tool_policy (agent_id, tool_id, auth_mode) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{toolId}, #{authMode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE auth_mode = VALUES(auth_mode), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
